# espalier_volumes (Data Source)

All volumes in the container runtime, optionally only those with certain labels.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Volumes labelled by another configuration.
data "espalier_volumes" "backups" {
  labels = { purpose = "backup" }
}

output "backup_volumes" {
  value = data.espalier_volumes.backups.volumes[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Only list volumes that have all of these labels, with these values.

### Read-Only

- `volumes` (Attributes List) The volumes ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `format` (String) Filesystem of the volume, e.g. `ext4`.
- `id` (String) The volume's name.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels attached to the volume.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume.
- `options` (Map of String) Driver-specific options (`--opt key=value`). Use `size` for the size, not an option.
- `size` (String) Size in bytes, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix, e.g. `2G`. If not set, the runtime creates a sparse 512 GiB image.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the volume in bytes.
- `source` (String) Host path of the volume's disk image.
